explication: eth-phishing-detect is a domain-list package for detecting phishing sites targeting Web3 users, with tools for maintaining its allow/block/fuzzy lists. The main runtime flow loads the bundled configuration into a detector and checks a supplied domain. Contribution tooling updates or cleans that configuration; a separate list-refresh tool maintains domain corpora used as false-positive safeguards. The graph reflects documented workflows and shown imports/calls; unsampled implementation details are omitted.
